# `Browser.Share.Internals`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Browser.Share.Internals — the low-level Web Share port surface: the closed
outbound/inbound ADTs and the raw `Ipe.Ffi.Js` request/subscribe wiring the
high-level `Ipe.Browser.Share` layer wraps.

Importing this submodule discloses the same `js-port:share` axis as the top-level
module (the disclosure is keyed on the `Ipe.Browser.Share` path prefix), so the
raw port surface cannot be reached undisclosed.

## `Payload`

The Web Share payload, mirroring the `ShareData` subset carried across the
seal. Every field is a plain string; an empty field is omitted before the Web
API call so the platform sheet only shows populated fields.

  * `title` — the shared title.
  * `text` — the shared body text.
  * `url` — the shared URL. The raw transport is untyped, so the served JS
    `share` sink allowlists its scheme to `http`/`https` before
    `navigator.share`: a `data:`/`file:`/`javascript:`/relative URL reaching
    this raw field is dropped fail-closed, independent of the high-level
    `ShareUrl` seal (defence in depth).

Crossing the seal as a single record keeps the outbound variant single-payload:
`Share payload` externally tags as `{ Share: { title, text, url } }`.

## `empty`

```ipe
empty : Payload
```

An empty payload (all fields blank) — a base to override the fields a caller
actually wants to share.

## `JsCmd`

The ONE closed OUTBOUND port type: the whole outbound surface as a single
auditable object. `Share payload` invokes the platform share sheet.

## `JsMsg`

The NARROW closed INBOUND port type — deliberately NOT the app's internal
`Msg`. Every variant the browser can push is enumerated, so the fold in the
high-level layer is EXHAUSTIVE and a cancellation can never be silently dropped:
it becomes a typed `Err`.

  * `Shared` — the share sheet completed successfully.
  * `Cancelled` — the user dismissed the share sheet (an `AbortError`).
  * `Unavailable` — the Web Share API is absent in this context.

## `request`

```ipe
request : JsCmd -> Cmd.Cmd msg
```

`request cmd` — hand a closed outbound `JsCmd` to the raw port transport.
The served first-party JS sink reaches `navigator.share`; the reply arrives
inbound as a `JsMsg`.

## `requestOne`

```ipe
requestOne : JsCmd -> Task Error JsMsg
```

`requestOne cmd` — correlated one-shot `JsCmd` → `Task Error JsMsg`.
Routes through `Js.request` with the `inbound` decoder so the correlated
reply is decoded fail-closed by the same gate the `subscribe` path uses.

## `subscribe`

```ipe
subscribe : (JsMsg -> msg) -> Sub.Sub msg
```

`subscribe toMsg` — the inbound subscription over the fail-closed seal
decoder. `inbound` IS the security gate; a malformed / mismatched frame is
dropped whole. A decoded `JsMsg` is handed to `toMsg`.

## `inbound`

```ipe
inbound : Decode.Decoder JsMsg
```

The total, fail-closed decoder for a `JsMsg` frame of this capability.

It first requires the frame's `tag` to be `portTag`, so a frame of another
capability, or an untagged one, fails closed; the rest decodes as `inboundBody`.
